hook: I run 70 bots. I write books. I post every day. It's just me.
script_lines: No team. No assistants. No agency on retainer.
Ten years ago this would've taken fifteen people and a six-figure budget.
Now it takes me, a laptop, and the right stack.
One AI writes the hooks. Another edits the clips. Another schedules the posts.
I'm the operator. They're the labor.
People ask me how I keep up. I don't. The machines do.
My job is taste. Direction. Pressing go.
This isn't the future. It's Tuesday.
cta: Book's out. AI for Traders and Creators. Link in bio.
